subject: Welcome to TrueCap — start your first property screen
preheader: Paste an address and review cap rate, cash flow, selected-rule fit, and a secondary Screening Index.
headline: You're in. Start with one property and verify the inputs.
body: Welcome to TrueCap. Paste a U.S. address and review cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, monthly cash flow, selected-rule fit, and a secondary Screening Index. Rent, mortgage rate, and property tax can start from labeled estimates, and you can edit anything. Verify every material input before relying on the result.
Try it on a property you're actually looking at right now. The fastest way to see if TrueCap fits how you work is to run a real deal, not a sample.
Reply to this email and tell me what you're hunting for — market, strategy, price range. I read every one.
